1.title: Instant Impact
1.description: Double Points for summer signings. One player per club.

2.title: Welcome Back
2.description: Double Points for players from the promoted clubs. Up to three players per club.

3.title: All Out Attack
3.description: Goals and assists are worth double points. One player per club.

4.title: Derby Day
4.description: Double Points for Manchester United and Manchester City players. Up to three players per club.

5.title: The Shield
5.description: Defensive Contributions score 10 points. One player per club.

6.title: Matchwinner
6.description: Winning Goals are worth an additional 10 points. One player per club. Unlimited budget.

7.title: Away Days
7.description: Players in away matches earn double points. One player per club. Unlimited budget.

8.title: Legends
8.description: Players who have been at their club for at least five years score double points. One player per club. Unlimited budget.

9.title: Trick or Treat
9.description: Players earn 3 points for every successful dribble but lose a point each time they are tackled. One player per club. Unlimited budget.

10.title: Spectacular
10.description: Your players earn +1 point for every shot on target from outside the penalty area and +5 points for every goal scored from outside the penalty area. One player per club. Unlimited budget.

11.title: Make the Call
11.description: Players who come on as a substitute earn triple points. One player per club. Unlimited budget.

12.title: Wonderkids
12.description: Players aged 23 or under at the final Gameweek 12 deadline earn double points. One player per club. Unlimited budget.

13.title: Dribbling: 20
13.description: Players earn +1 point for every successful dribble and a one-off +5 points for three or more. One player per club. Unlimited budget.
